summary: As of mid August 2026 there is no comprehensive Russia and Ukraine ceasefire. Lavrov said on 14 August that Russia will not accept a ceasefire freezing the current front line, Russia refused a Black Sea ceasefire proposal, and Ukrainian military intelligence said on 18 August that Russia shows no sign of readiness. The only pauses in 2026 were short truces, including a 32 hour Orthodox Easter truce on 11 April during which Ukraine reported 469 violations.
rationale: The claim is a clean binary and he chose a side. Asked on 12 May 2026 which conflict would stop first, he said he heard by the spirit that Ukraine and Russia would stop first and not Iran. Iran stopped first: American and Israeli strikes on Iran halted in early June 2026 and a memorandum was announced on 14 June, while the Ukraine war was still running in mid August with Russia publicly refusing a front line freeze. There is no ambiguity to score around here, no condition attached and no window to wait out, which is why this is entered as contradicted rather than left open.
